tuned_threshold_metrics.selection_method: F1-maximizing cutoff from precision_recall_curve on training predictions
tuned_threshold_metrics.tradeoff_note: The default 0.5 cutoff (see 'metrics') favors recall because the classifier uses class_weight="balanced" on an imbalanced label. This tuned cutoff was chosen to maximize F1 on training predictions and generally raises precision at the cost of some recall; compare the two blocks to judge the tradeoff for your review workflow.
